title: Your first 30 days as a data analyst: the day-by-day plan
caption:
Nobody tells freshers what to do after the offer letter.
This is the month I'd plan: learn the data, own one report, speed it up, then bring your first insight. Every day says when you are done.
Follow @thedataguy16 and comment FIRST30. I'll DM you the full 8-page PDF.
Want the complete 90-day system? Link in bio.
why: Proven: 45-day roadmap carousel 29,498 views / 95 follows; 'plan in N days' hooks median reach 125K (n=4). Tool plans all ran within 60 days, so this plan covers the first month at work, an angle not used yet. Replaces the planned Excel interview list (owner rejected that on 22 Oct). Hook family: before day one; cover B: save before.
